# ob-34 — Document that a site or prober column with neither value nor range prints empty cells

**Findings:** Obfuscator/TestResultsGenerator.cs fixed-column value fallback prints empty cells; README.md and Obfuscator/PackageReadme.md are silent. · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Follow-up from ob-28. A site or prober column configured with neither `value` nor `range` prints empty, padded cells, and the docs don't say so. Targeted to v0.2.0.

## Files

README.md and Obfuscator/PackageReadme.md, where they describe test-results device columns; Obfuscator.Tests/ObfuscatorTests.cs only if no test pins the behaviour yet.

## Failing tests

- If no existing test pins it: a site column and a prober column with neither `value` nor `range` print cells that hold only spaces, padded to the column width, on every device row.

## Implement

In README.md, where the test-results device columns are described, state that a site or prober column with neither `value` nor `range` prints empty, padded cells. Add the same point to PackageReadme.md's test-results line, keeping it short. Change no code.

## Check

Run `dotnet test Obfuscator.slnx` and `dotnet format Obfuscator.slnx --verify-no-changes`.
